source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Go to the location that is inspected and document everything in the inspection record for the building in a text document.  This can be done on the phone with text to speech (one hander for the phone, and the other to write down what is being said, or have someone to type what’s being said so it’s easier)
3. For each problem encountered, take a picture/pictures of said problem, from different angles if needed, and if needed a video of what happened to trigger the accessible building check to fail.
4. Include the text file, the photos/videos in an email to sg_info@altgadgets.co.za, and the location of where the photos/videos taken and where the building is actually located will be needed, for context.
5. The problem will be forwarded to the specific building owner.
<eos>
